After departure, note for first-time travelers
Please give it some attention

Travelers should review their companion animal handoff steps before arrival at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Follow the carrier checks, label placement, and document review that the desk confirms at the counter. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, so each item must be ready, secure, and easy to identify. Keep the travel note with you and keep your pet calm while staff complete the intake steps.

If you are sending a pet through the next service point, stay close to the instructions given by the passenger coordinator. Use the approved carrier only, and make sure the latch, bedding, and water setup are in place before you approach the desk. Bring any required travel papers in one bundle so the review stays smooth. If anything changes with your itinerary or your pet's condition, tell the desk at once so the team can adjust the handling plan.

For clear help and same-day direction, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
